Most UI art is English already (MECHANIC, MUSEUM, PICTURE, CHARACTER, RECORD, REPLAY, AUTOPLAY, NO PICTURE, SET/CLEAR, OPERATE MENU, ATTENTION, NO DATA); Japanese is limited to the battle-record (war data) panels, the rank ribbons and the copyright line. menu_load: 480x272 loading-screen wallpapers (Macross II, Macross 7, Dynamite 7, DYRL, Frontier, Flash Back 2012, SDF Macross, Plus, Zero, character cards, mecha renders) with a series logo top corner and the MUF logo bottom right; plus 8 tip cards (mac00001-mac00008) full of Japanese, and three anime stills with in-scene Japanese (f_003 poster, f_008 Nyan-Nyan menu, f_043 weapon caption). menu_face_s/m/ss/l: pilot face icons, no text, except the Auto Select / No Sortie / Restricted placeholder cards in face_s and face_m. menu_mecha_s/m/l/ss: unit head renders, no text; pack icons are English (SUPER PACK, ARMORED PACK, STRIKE PACK, SOUND EQUIPMENT, BOOSTER EQUIPMENT, STANDARD EQUIPMENT, MOVIE VER., TV VER., FAST PACK); mecha_s and mecha_l also hold the Auto Select / No Sortie / Restricted / Standby placeholder cards. (kanji logo and subtitle), The Super Dimension Fortress Macross / Flash Back 2012 (kanji over-title), Macross Frontier (katakana logo) and Macross Zero (small katakana under the English logo), incl. the large watermark logo on Macross 7 art cards 7_079-7_112 and the same logos on the gallery thumbnails. Judgement call: the Macross Plus stills (menu_load/plus_002 onward incl. plus_ch/ed/op, about 100 files, and the matching gallery thumbnails picture_s__plus_*) carry a small plain katakana series tag reading 'Macross Plus' top left, not the stylised official logo. English already in art and left alone: RANKA LEE, SHERYL NOME, MACROSS FRONTIER, Lynn Minmay, To The NEW FRONTIER MEGAROAD-01, MINMEI, WANTED, LIVE ON ICE, MACROSS banners on character cards.

Japanese-script series logos and tags with their official English titles, for reference only. Decision (user, 2026-10-15): keep all official logos as they are; only plain-text images are redrawn.

rows.en:
Pinon Colette's
"★Macross Ultimate Frontier for Beginners"
- First, master the basic controls in the Tutorial.
(Ranka and Sheryl will walk you through everything.)
- After clearing a mission, spend Tune Points
to keep powering up your units.
- The Nyan-Nyan Shop stocks everything from units
to BGM -- the hottest shop in the super-galaxy!
- In NETWORK mode, you can enjoy every
mission together with your friends.
- Put your favorite BGM in the Memory Stick™ folder
and you'll be able to listen to it during battle.
That's all from Pinon Colette!

rows.en:
Yui Hoshimura's
"Leave It to Me, It's a Breeze★ Combat Edition"
- When you spot an enemy, first lock on with the R button.
- Once you're locked on, fire missiles with the ○ button!!
With multi-lock missiles, hold down the ○ button
to add more targets!
- When the SP Gauge is full, press △ and ○ together
to unleash a powerful SP Attack!
Every unit has its own SP Attacks, so check them out!!
A Combo SP Attack fires together with your wingman,
but each one's attack power is lower, so be careful.
- If a locked-on enemy has a "★ mark",
watch out! It'll hit you with a powerful SP Attack!
- After a battle, power up your units with Tune Points
and you're all set! Easy-peasy★
That's all from Yui Hoshimura!

rows.en:
Luis Fernando's
"Show Me Your Passion!! Rescue & Lock-On Level Edition"
■Rescue System
- Lock onto a disabled wingman and fly in close to repair
them on the spot and get them back in the fight!!
(They revive with 25% HP. You can rescue any number of times.)
★You can rescue in wireless co-op and versus play too!!
■Lock-On Level System
- Point your unit's nose at the enemy to raise the lock-on level.
Fire missiles at a high lock-on level and
their power and accuracy go way UP!!
(The lock-on sight's color shows your lock-on level:
green 1.3x, yellow 1.0x, red 0.75x.)
That's all. You'd better come back alive!!
That's a promise, man to man!!

rows.en:
Sheryl Nome's
"Listen to My Lecture~★ Support Character Edition"
■Support Characters
- Support characters can use two kinds of skills:
"Command Skills" and "Auto Skills."
●Command Skills (press ○ and × together)
- They use up the SP Gauge, and you trigger them whenever you like.
(Galactic Fairy: your unit's and allies' attack power rises
1.5x, and HP gradually recovers.)
●Auto Skills
- Skills that trigger by themselves when certain conditions are met.
(Pineapple Cake: when your HP hits 0%, it recovers
and you're invincible for a while. *Once only)
★Support characters grow too, and keep learning new skills.
That's all -- explained by none other than
Sheryl Nome! You should be grateful!!

rows.en:
Alto Saotome's
"You're My Wings!! Real Flight & Anti-Missile Action Edition"
■Real Flight Controls
- Come feel the overwhelming speed and immersion for yourself.
In exchange, it takes some pretty advanced piloting,
so be ready for it.
If you've got the skills, give it a shot!!
(We recommend starting out with Normal Flight controls.)
■Anti-Missile Action
- When an enemy fires missiles at you,
Missile Markers appear on screen.
Press □ and × together to trigger
Anti-Missile Action and shoot the missiles down
one after another!!
(Some units dodge missiles with barriers or jamming instead.)
That's all. This much should be a breeze for you guys.

rows.en:
Elma Hoilie's
"Please Make Me Your Apprentice! Add-on Equipment &
Sortie-Restricted Units Edition"
■Add-on Equipment
- Equip it and your unit's parameters go up, and you can use
powerful dedicated weapons and dedicated SP Attacks~★
(Dedicated SP Attacks only work when TYPE B is selected~★)
★Watch out for ones that can't take Fighter mode on the ground~★
- VF-1 with Super Pack, VF-171EX with Armored Pack
- VF-25 with Super Pack or Armored Pack
(GERWALK performance drops too, so purging might be smart~★)
■Sortie-Restricted Units
- These units can't sortie in missions that go into space~★
TYPE-14, TYPE-29, Cheyenne, Octos
VF-0D, VF-0A, VF-0S, Prototype Monster
SV-51α, SV-51γ (Nora), SV-51γ (Ivanov)
That's all from Elma Hoilie~★

rows.en:
Ishtar's
"So This Is the Power of Ars! Ultimate Mode, Versus Mode &
Wallpaper Edition"
■Ultimate Mode
- Meet certain conditions and you can select ultra-hard missions.
(Press the △ button on the mission select screen.)
Gather every bit of strength you have and take on the challenge!!
(They're easier to clear with friends in wireless co-op.)
■Versus Mode
- In wireless versus play, up to 4 players can battle.
The recommended rule settings are:
Free Battle, Unlimited Respawns, 3-min Time Limit, LIMIT 50
Free Battle, No Respawns, 3-min Time Limit, LIMIT 50, 2-on-2 Teams
★Hits on the 1st-place team score triple points!! Go for the comeback!!
(Recommended maps: Wild Plain, In the Dark, Vajra Frontier)
■Wallpapers
- There are 1,024 in all. Collect them all and enjoy
Macross's greatest scenes through the ages in the Gallery!!
That's all from Ishtar.
